Shruti Kumari Data Management Specialist ■ +91 9920342156 | ■ Bengaluru | ■ Shrutijha2608@gmail.com

Professional Summary Data Management Specialist with over 5 years of experience managing and validating business-critical data across CRM, financial, and research environments. Skilled in data cleansing, reporting, and documentation using Microsoft Excel, Tableau, and CRM systems. Strong understanding of data governance, compliance, and audit readiness. Proven ability to improve data accuracy, streamline workflows, and collaborate across functions to support data-driven decisions.

Core Competencies Data Quality & Governance | Data Validation & Cleansing | Reporting & Dashboarding | Data Documentation & Audit Support | CRM Data Management | Process Improvement & Standardization | Stakeholder Coordination | Compliance & Data Controls

Technical Skills Tools: Excel (VLOOKUP, PivotTables, Macros), Tableau, Power BI, CRM Systems Database: SQL (Basic Knowledge) Techniques: Data Cleaning, Transformation, Metrics Analysis, Visualization & Storytelling

Professional Experience JPMorgan Chase & Co. — Data Management Specialist Nov 2021 – Present | Bengaluru • Manage data maintenance and validation for client and product records, ensuring data accuracy and completeness across internal systems. • Conduct regular data reviews to identify inconsistencies, duplicates, and missing information, coordinating corrective actions with business users. • Support governance policies by maintaining data change logs, approvals, and audit documentation. • Prepare recurring data quality and exception reports for management review. • Develop and maintain interactive Tableau dashboards to visualize vendor and data quality KPIs. • Partner with IT and business teams to streamline data entry and monitoring procedures, reducing manual errors. • Participate in user training sessions to reinforce best practices in data management. • Contribute to process improvement initiatives that enhance data reliability and reporting timeliness.

HighRadius Technologies — Market Research Analyst Jun 2021 – Nov 2021 | Bengaluru • Monitored data quality KPIs, analyzed process performance, and proposed actionable improvements. • Utilized secondary research for data scraping, mining, and conversion into structured, meaningful datasets. • Conducted account and contact profiling to identify potential business opportunities. • Ensured marketing database hygiene through regular data cleansing and enrichment.

SiliconIndia Technologies Pvt. Ltd. — Market Research Executive Aug 2018 – Feb 2020 | Bengaluru • Conducted research and profiling of companies across US, EMEA, and APAC markets. • Developed innovative methods for identifying key decision-makers and business contacts using portals like LinkedIn, Crunchbase, and ZoomInfo. • Collected and analyzed data on venture capital, private equity, and investment trends. • Compiled insights and competitor analyses for client companies. • Managed and maintained datasets in Excel for reporting and client deliverables.

Education Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) – Computer Science Engineering Bengal College of Engineering & Technology, Durgapur — DGPA: 7.64 (2015) 12th – M.P. High School, Sitamarhi (Bihar) — 63% (2010) 10th – Kamala Girls High School, Sitamarhi (Bihar) — 63% (2008)

Key Highlights Recognized for maintaining high accuracy in data validation and reporting at J.P. Morgan. Developed dashboards and templates that improved visibility into data quality KPIs. Successfully contributed to several process improvement initiatives reducing manual errors.
